sloka: ततो भुक्तवतां तेषां तदन्नममृतोपमम् ।दिव्यानुद्वीक्ष्य भक्ष्यांस्तानभवद्भक्षणे मति: ॥ २.९१.६२॥
transliteration: tato bhuktavatāṁ teṣāṁ tadannamamṛtopamam ।divyānudvīkṣya bhakṣyāṁstānabhavadbhakṣaṇe mati: ॥ 2.91.62॥

translations.english: The exceedingly delighted soldiers of Bharata's retinue in their thousands cried out with excitement This is the very heaven.
